findings.title: Ingresses send the same host and path to different Services
findings.cause: Ingress shop-v2 sends shop.example.com/ to Service web-v2:80, which Ingress shop sends to Service web:80; only one of them gets the traffic, which one being up to the controller (ingress-nginx keeps the oldest rule)

evidence.command: kubectl get ingress shop-v2 -n kd-ingress-route-conflict -o jsonpath='{.metadata.creationTimestamp}{" "}{.spec.rules}'

evidence.what: Ingress shop routes shop.example.com/ to Service web:80
evidence.command: kubectl get ingress shop -n kd-ingress-route-conflict -o jsonpath='{.metadata.creationTimestamp}{" "}{.spec.rules}'

findings.fix: Give each host and path one Ingress: delete the stale rule, or change the host or path of one of them. For a canary, use the controller's canary feature rather than a second Ingress.
